why: Cloud V0 item 1, harness login attached in advance (Leo: "A chat starts in a few seconds: ready spare, harness login attached in advance"). The App part is the binding over App-only types: the two intent hooks (AppDelegate activation, AgentPageChats' Cloud reservation), CloudService's CloudSpareWarms (the in-flight tracking, in CmuxNextCloud), and passHarnessLogin taking a LoginTarget so the warm reuses the start's owner check and transfer instead of duplicating them, with its owner-only and identity guards. The warm policy (team, copy target, throttle, attempts, abandoned copies) is Rust (cmux-tui start_chat_cli/spare_warm.rs, cmux-cloud-start-core), the CLI call and SpareWarm.copyAllowed in CmuxNextCloud, the warm route in cmux-platform#1016.
